title: Why South Park Changed the Show’s Name & What It Means for the Series’ Future
content: South Park has announced that it has changed the name of the show after 29 years ahead of the release of the new season, and it’s likely that the premiere will help to explain this shift.
author: ComicBook

title: Level 5 Announces Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain Game for Switch 2
content: Level 5 announced during the English Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday a new updated verison of the Yo-kai Watch 2 Nintendo 3DS game titled Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain for Nintendo Switch 2. The English-subtitled video shows Jibanyan, Whisper, and series' protagonist Nate (Keita in Japan).
author: ANN

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Novel/Webtoon Gets Anime
content: A new official website opened on Thursday to announce that writer Sinnoa's and artist Neida's SSS-Class Revival Hunter web novel and webtoon are getting an anime adaptation in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: New Naruto Anime Movie Will Reportedly Be Revealed Very Soon
content: It sounds like Naruto is coming back with a new anime movie project according to a new report ahead of some big plans the franchise has for New York Comic Con 2026 this October.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece: Elbaph Arc Reveals How Many Episodes Are Left Before Finale
content: One Piece has been working through the first phase of the Elbaph Arc since the TV anime made its return earlier this Spring, and it has revealed how many episodes are left to go before it all comes to an end.
author: ComicBook

title: Persona 4 Revival, Persona 6 Games Get Switch 2 Releases
content: Atlus announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, and Persona 6 , a new game in the Persona series, are both coming to Nintendo Switch 2. Persona 4 Revival will launch on Switch 2 on May 20.
author: ANN

title: Monster Hunter Wilds Game Gets Switch 2 Release on December 4
content: CAPCOM revealed during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday a trailer for its Monster Hunter Wilds game, and it teases that the game will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4. The video also reveals local play between Switch 2 systems.
author: ANN

title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity Game Gets Definitive Edition for Switch 2
content: Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that it and Koei Tecmo 's Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity game will get a Definitive Edition. Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity Definitive Edition will launch for Nintendo Switch 2 on February 25: The Definitive Edition will feature improved visuals…
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super’s New Remake Confirms First Streaming Home Ahead of Fall 2026 Debut
content: Dragon Ball Super is now in the works on coming back to screens with a new TV anime remake series adapting the original from the very beginning, and it has confirmed its first streaming platform ahead of its launch in Japan this Fall.
author: ComicBook

title: Professor Layton and The New World of Steam Game's Trailer Reveals December 10 Release
content: Level 5 unveiled during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday a new trailer for Professor Layton and The New World of Steam ( Layton Kyōju to Jōki no Shinsekai ), and it reveals that the game will launch on December 10 worldwide for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam.
author: ANN
